content: More recently, BIBREF12 propose to leverage the gloss information from WordNet and model the semantic relationship between the context and gloss in an improved memory network. Similarly, BIBREF13 introduce a (hierarchical) co-attention mechanism to generate co-dependent representations for the context and gloss. Their attempts prove that incorporating gloss knowledge into supervised WSD approach is helpful, but they still have not achieved much improvement, because they may not make full use of gloss knowledge.
